title: Sum in a Matrix
summary: Given a 0-indexed 2D integer array nums, begin with a score of 0.
statement: Given a 0-indexed 2D integer array nums, begin with a score of 0. Repeatedly, select the largest number from each row, remove it, and then add the highest number among the selected numbers to the score. Continue this process until the matrix is empty. Return the final score.
constraints: Every row has the same positive length.
In each round remove the largest remaining number from every row, then add the largest removed number to the score.
Return the score after all columns’ worth of rounds.
hints: At a fixed sorted column, those values are exactly the elements removed in the same round when maxima are removed repeatedly.
Add the maximum across rows for each column.
Sorting only reorders each row’s removal sequence, and every round contribution is therefore represented by one aligned column maximum.
editorial: Sorting only reorders each row’s removal sequence, and every round contribution is therefore represented by one aligned column maximum.

tests.explanation: Round maxima seven, five, and three sum to fifteen.
The only round removes all values and contributes the largest, three.
